title: Progressive Can Survive Without Me Chili Mac
description: The creamy, hearty chili mac that officially beat the headset: deluxe mac and cheese, ground turkey, chili with beans, extra chili powder, and Parmesan on top.

ingredients.item: deluxe macaroni and cheese with cheese sauce pouch
chili powder, plus more to taste

steps.text: Brown the ground turkey in a large skillet, breaking it up as it cooks.
Prepare the deluxe macaroni and cheese according to the box directions, using the included cheese sauce pouch.
Stir both cans of chili with beans and the extra chili powder into the cooked turkey. Heat until hot and bubbly.
Fold the prepared mac and cheese into the turkey-chili mixture until everything is creamy and evenly combined.
Spoon into bowls and top generously with grated Parmesan cheese.

cookSteps.text:
BROWN:
{{turkey}} ground turkey

Break it up as it cooks.

PREPARE:
{{mac}} deluxe macaroni and cheese

Cook the pasta according to the box directions, drain it, then stir in the included cheese sauce pouch.

ADD TO THE TURKEY:
{{chili}} chili with beans
{{powder}} chili powder

Stir and heat until hot and bubbly.
FOLD the prepared mac and cheese into the hot turkey-chili mixture until creamy and evenly combined.

SPOON into bowls.
TOP WITH:
{{parm}} grated Parmesan

Add another shake of chili powder if you want it punchier.

storage: Refrigerate leftovers up to 4 days. Reheat gently in the microwave or on the stove; add a small splash of milk if it thickens.
